Clay

Turn account context into a relevant sales conversation.

COfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Clay connects account research, enrichment, and buying signals with a structured prospecting process. MoreSpace can build a target-account workspace that prioritizes relevant buyers, supplies useful personalization fields, and refreshes CRM records before sales outreach.

Useful outputs

  • Enriched accounts with source and confidence fields
  • Prioritized prospect lists and personalization context
  • CRM updates and actionable sales handoff records

Where we can apply it

  • Target-account list → enrichment → fit score → reviewed Smartlead sequence.
  • New CRM record → completeness checks → enrichment → owner-ready context.
  • Buying signal → account research → sales task → pipeline outcome review.
01

Use case 1

Enrich target accounts with company context and decision-maker details.

02

Use case 2

Prioritize prospects using an agreed ideal customer profile and buying signals.

03

Use case 3

Refresh CRM records and prepare personalized outreach fields.

Inputs we need

  • Ideal customer profile and target markets
  • Authorized account lists and existing CRM records
  • Approved enrichment sources and contact rules

Delivery sequence

  • Define account criteria, required fields, and data acceptance rules.
  • Configure enrichment and scoring, then test representative records.
  • Connect approved outputs to outreach and monitor data quality.

Expert review points

  • Review ambiguous account matches before records enter sales sequences.
  • Approve scoring rules and personal-data handling before activation.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • Apollo
  • HubSpot
  • Smartlead
  • HTTP APIs

Signals we can make visible

  • Enrichment coverage
  • Data completeness
  • Qualified account rate
  • Pipeline generated
